qualifier: NOTCH2-4 paralogs, Th2 and pancreatic bud contexts
name: NOTCH2-4 intracellular domain transcriptional output
rationale: Every member concerns transcription driven by released Notch intracellular domains of NOTCH2, NOTCH3 and NOTCH4 and its developmental and Th2 readouts, while the confusables are built around NOTCH1 activation and its constitutively active variants.

qualifier: alpha-2 Gi/Gz-coupled inhibition of adenylate cyclase
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: All members are adrenoceptor responses to adrenaline and noradrenaline that act by inhibiting adenylate cyclase through Gi/Gz and so damp insulin and catecholamine secretion, unlike confusables covering cAMP/PKA generally or beta-adrenergic cardiac and vascular output.

qualifier: spinal cord motor neuron and interneuron fate
name: Dorsoventral spinal cord patterning and motor neuron specification
rationale: Members are neural plate and neural tube dorsoventral patterning events together with floor plate, spinal interneuron and motor neuron fate specification, whereas confusables sit in hindbrain, midbrain dopaminergic or axial mesoderm territory.

qualifier: glucose output, caloric restriction and beta-cell
name: Circadian and nutrient-sensing control of glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members tie clock transcription and locomotor rhythm to caloric restriction, redox state, acetylation, gluconeogenesis and beta-cell growth, while confusables centre on PGC-1alpha/PPARA mitochondrial biogenesis or glucocorticoid responses.

qualifier: monocyte and neutrophil innate effector state
name: Monocyte and neutrophil myeloid identity and activation
rationale: All members are monocyte, neutrophil or activated myeloid transcriptional signatures plus monocyte activation and cellular defence, whereas confusables are dendritic-cell and monocyte surface signatures, TLR inflammatory signalling or degranulation.

qualifier: mitochondrial iron supply to TCA enzymes and tetrapyrrole control
name: Iron-sulfur cluster assembly and mitochondrial iron utilization
rationale: Members cover cytosolic and mitochondrial Fe-S cluster assembly, Fe-S-dependent TCA enzyme maturation, mitochondrial ABC iron transporters and the regulation of tetrapyrrole and hemoglobin synthesis, while confusables are heme biosynthesis itself, complex III assembly or ferredoxin electron transfer.

qualifier: intestinal absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly
name: Intestinal dietary lipid absorption and chylomicron assembly
rationale: Members all concern digestion and intestinal absorption of dietary lipid and sterols and the assembly of nascent chylomicrons and VLDL, whereas confusables cover remodelling, clearance and efflux of circulating lipoprotein particles.

qualifier: histone stem-loop processing and snRNA/snRNP handling
name: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and nuclear RNA export
rationale: Members span cleavage and polyadenylation, histone stem-loop 3'-end processing, polymerase II termination and export of mature mRNA and snRNA from the nucleus, while confusables emphasise cytoplasmic mRNA decay, snRNA transcription or the spliceosome.

qualifier: with CD40, MHC class II and antigen presentation control
name: Myeloid TLR inflammatory signalling and antigen presentation control
rationale: Members combine monocyte and dendritic-cell receptor modules and TLR/MyD88 inflammatory signalling with regulation of CD40, MHC class II and T cell antigen presentation, unlike confusables focused on cytokine-production regulation or Fc receptor and neutrophil effector function.

qualifier: elongation, ether-lipid use and peroxisomal beta-oxidation
name: Very-long-chain fatty acid elongation and peroxisomal beta-oxidation
rationale: Members are the synthesis, elongation and acyl-CoA activation of very-long-chain and polyunsaturated fatty acids together with their peroxisomal beta-oxidation and plasmalogen use, whereas confusables add sterol synthesis, alpha-oxidation or peroxisome protein import.

core: Clostridial neurotoxin action at the nerve terminal
qualifier: SNARE cleavage blocking vesicle fusion
name: Clostridial neurotoxin cleavage of neuronal SNARE proteins
rationale: Every member is the toxicity of a botulinum serotype or tetanus toxin, which cleave neuronal SNARE proteins and block synaptic vesicle fusion, whereas confusables are ordinary neurotransmitter synthesis, transport and reuptake pathways.

qualifier: metaphase-anaphase transition and mitotic exit
name: APC/C-dependent degradation at metaphase-anaphase and mitotic exit
rationale: All members concern activation, inhibition and substrate degradation by the anaphase-promoting complex with its Cdc20 and Cdh1 partners during the metaphase-anaphase transition and mitotic exit, while confusables cover spindle and kinetochore function, sister chromatid cohesion or the G2/M transition.

qualifier: with diacylglycerol-derived endocannabinoid signalling
name: Glycerophospholipid synthesis, acyl-chain remodelling and endocannabinoid release
rationale: Members are the de novo synthesis, catabolism and acyl-chain remodelling of the glycerophospholipid classes plus the acylethanolamide and monoacylglycerol signals derived from them, whereas confusables are sphingolipid metabolism, lipid transfer between membranes or neutral glyceride synthesis.

qualifier: receptor-mediated uptake of LDL, VLDL, HDL and chylomicron remnants
name: Plasma lipoprotein remodelling and receptor-mediated clearance
rationale: Members are remodelling and clearance of circulating lipoprotein particles and the cholesterol import and storage they drive, whereas confusables include lipoprotein assembly, intestinal absorption, lipase complexes and cholesterol efflux.

qualifier: intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde direction
name: COPI-mediated intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-endoplasmic reticulum retrograde transport
rationale: All members describe COPI coat budding and the retrograde and intra-Golgi transport steps it serves, while confusables cover vesicle tethering, Golgi architecture, COPII anterograde export or trans-Golgi and lysosomal biogenesis.

qualifier: visual cycle and retinoic acid turnover, with their genetic defects
name: Retinoid metabolism and the visual retinoid cycle
rationale: Members cover vitamin A and retinoid transport, storage, oxidation and retinoic acid turnover, the rod and cone retinoid cycles and the disease events that disrupt them, whereas confusables are steroid, vitamin D or vitamin K metabolism and phototransduction itself.

qualifier: heterochromatin-based proliferative arrest
name: Oncogene-induced senescence and senescent heterochromatin formation
rationale: Members are oncogene-induced senescence, its control in both directions, and the heterochromatin formation and G0 entry that enforce the arrest, whereas confusables add the secretory phenotype, oxidative-stress and replicative senescence, or defects that let cells evade senescence.

qualifier: fatty acid, muscarinic and incretin ligands
name: Nutrient and incretin receptor amplification of insulin secretion
rationale: All three members are receptor-driven potentiation of beta-cell insulin secretion by free fatty acids, acetylcholine and GLP-1, whereas confusables are adrenergic inhibition of secretion, other peptide receptor families, or insulin and incretin synthesis.

qualifier: death receptor and BH3/mitochondrial routes with necroptosis
name: Death receptor and BH3-driven apoptosis with necroptotic signalling
rationale: Members are the extrinsic death receptor and caspase-8 branch, BH3 protein activation with mitochondrial permeabilisation and apoptosome and nuclease steps, and the necroptotic alternative, whereas confusables add p53 transcriptional control of cell death or senescence.

qualifier: heparan, chondroitin and dermatan chain elongation
name: Heparan, chondroitin and dermatan sulfate chain biosynthesis
rationale: Members are the biosynthesis of heparan, heparin, chondroitin and dermatan sulfate proteoglycan chains, including the EXT1/EXT2 exostosis defects in heparan chain elongation, whereas confusables are the common linkage-region steps, chondroitin sulfation disorders or Notch-directed O-glycosylation.

qualifier: phospholipase A2 arachidonate release and fever
name: Phospholipase A2 arachidonate release and prostaglandin production control
rationale: Members are the release of arachidonate by phospholipase A2 and the positive and negative regulation of prostaglandin synthesis and secretion with their fever and prostaglandin E responses, whereas confusables are the cyclooxygenase reactions themselves or leukotriene and lipoxin branches.

qualifier: T cell polarity and membrane raft recruitment
name: Immunological synapse formation and T cell polarity
rationale: All members concern lymphocyte contact and the polarised, raft-dependent organisation that forms an immunological synapse, whereas confusables are chemokine and Rho GTPase migration signalling or integrin-mediated adhesion and homing.

qualifier: polymerase I and III transcription with rRNA processing
name: Polymerase I and III rRNA synthesis, processing and translation initiation
rationale: Members are nucleolar polymerase I and polymerase III transcription, rRNA cleavage and processing, and the assembly of the cytoplasmic initiation complex and chain elongation, whereas confusables add MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis regulation, nucleolar chromatin control or snRNA transcription.

qualifier: oligodendrocyte lineage and reactive gliosis
name: Oligodendrocyte central nervous system myelination and reactive gliosis
rationale: Members are central myelin formation and maintenance, its negative regulation, oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and the glial reaction accompanying it, whereas confusables are Schwann cell and peripheral myelin, axon regeneration, nodal organisation or astrocyte-specific behaviour.

qualifier: neural plate and tube regionalization with somite segmentation
name: Embryonic axial patterning of neural tube and somites
rationale: Members are anteroposterior and dorsoventral patterning of the neural plate, tube and spinal cord together with somitogenesis, axial mesoderm and notochord formation and the neural crest and boundary decisions along that axis, whereas confusables are HOX cluster activation itself or craniofacial, limb and organ morphogenesis.
